query:
UPDATE "Node"
           SET "cpuUsage" = $2, "memUsage" = $3,
               version = CASE WHEN $4::text IS NULL OR $4 = '' THEN version ELSE $4 END,
               "lastCheckAt" = $5,
               status = CASE WHEN status = 'MAINTENANCE'::"NodeStatus"
                             THEN status ELSE 'ONLINE'::"NodeStatus" END,
               "updatedAt" = $5
           WHERE id = $1
